name: Bjørn Halvorsen
bio:
Bjørn Halvorsen's journey into motorsport began not in a garage, but on the icy roads of Norway, tinkering with rally cars alongside his father. That early exposure ignited a passion that led him to pursue engineering studies, specializing in vehicle dynamics. After graduating, he worked as a junior mechanic for a local racing team before transitioning into a more organizational role. He joined ART Grand Prix three years ago, bringing his practical experience and technical understanding to the crucial role of test driver coordinator.

Bjørn is meticulous in his approach, ensuring every test session is optimized for data collection and driver development. He believes in fostering open communication between the drivers, engineers, and mechanics, creating a collaborative environment where everyone can contribute their best. His keen eye for detail and ability to anticipate potential issues make him an invaluable asset to the team, ensuring that every track test translates to improvements on the race circuit. Bjørn's ambition isn't just personal; he is driven to see ART Grand Prix at the pinnacle of motorsport.

physical.description: Bjørn is of average height with a sturdy build, reflecting years spent working on cars.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on brewing his own strong coffee, even on the road.
